title: flow-screen-charge-component.html
content: The Flow Screen Charge component (PaymentChargeFlow) creates a {{variable.Object_PaymentMethod}} and charge {{variable.Object_Transaction}} with clicks, not code. This flow component can be configured for internal or customer-facing scenarios and used with standard or custom objects. Create a Flow Before you begin, please determine the Parent object for the {{variable.Object_Transaction}} (Charge) object. (The Parent object was configured in the Payments Setup Wizard.) For this example, we will use the {{variable.Object_Opportunity}} object as our {{variable.Object_Transaction}} Parent. Click the {{variable.Button_GearIcon}} Click {{variable.Button_Setup}} . In the Quick Find box, search for and click "Flows." Click New Flow .   Select "Screen Flow" and click Create .   Create a Get Records Element Click the + symbol (Add Element) between the Start and End elements.   Under Data, select Get Records . Fill in the following fields. This step quieries the Opportunity for the fields you want to pass into the PaymentChargeFlow component. If you unfamiliar configuring the Get Records step, please review the Flow Trailhead modules . {{variable.SF_Flow_Label}} (required) {{variable.SF_Flow_Object}} (required) {{variable.SF_Flow_Field}} (required)   Review the additional options. Close the Get Records window. Create an "Enter Card" Screen Element Click the + symbol (Add Element) between the Get Records and End elements.   Under Interaction, select Screen . Enter a {{variable.SF_Flow_Label}} . (required) (In this example, we used “Enter Card.”) Un-check the {{variable.SF_Flow_ShowHeader}} field since the component already contains a header. Review the footer configurations. Under the Components tab, locate the PaymentChargeFlow component and drag and drop it on the new screen. Fill in the required fields. {{variable.SF_Flow_APIName}} {{variable.SF_Flow_IsForCustomer}}   Complete the optional fields as needed. To learn more about each field, hover over each help icon. Values entered such as {{variable.SF_Flow_Currency}} = “USD” can be hard-coded. Or they can be mapped from fields such as {!opp_record.Amount} on the Transaction Parent (the Opportunity in this example). NOTE: Most fields may default to values if not set. {{variable.SF_Flow_PaymentGatewayId}} {{variable.SF_Flow_AmountToCharge}} {{variable.SF_Flow_Currency}} {{variable.SF_Flow_ChargeDescription}} {{variable.SF_Flow_ChargeParentId}} {{variable.SF_Flow_AccountId}} {{variable.SF_Flow_ContactId}} {{variable.SF_Flow_InOutPMId}} {{variable.SF_Flow_InOutTransactionId}}   Create a PaymentMethodId Field Click the Fields tab. Click in the {{variable.SF_Flow_RecordVariables}} field and click + New Resource . Fill in the following fields. {{variable.SF_Flow_APIName}} = “PaymentMethodId” (required) {{variable.SF_Flow_DataType}} = “Text” (required) {{variable.SF_Flow_AvailableForInput}} = “True” (checked) {{variable.SF_Flow_AvailableForOutput}} = “True” (checked)   Click {{variable.Button_Done}} . Create a TransactionId Field Click the Fields tab. Click in the {{variable.SF_Flow_RecordVariables}} field and click + New Resource . Fill in the following fields. {{variable.SF_Flow_APIName}} = “TransactionId” (required {{variable.SF_Flow_DataType}} = “Text” (required {{variable.SF_Flow_AvailableForInput}} = “True” (checked {{variable.SF_Flow_AvailableForOutput}} = “True” (checked)   Click {{variable.Button_Done}} . Configure the Advanced Settings Click the + symbol (Add Element) between the PaymentChargeFlow component and open the Advanced section. Check the {{variable.SF_Flow_ManuallyAssignVariable}} checkbox. Set {{variable.SF_Flow_InOutPMId}} = “{!PaymentMethodId]" and {{variable.SF_Flow_InOutTransactionId}} = “{!TransactionId}." You must enter values in these fields so the multi-step flow will know if the Payment Charge step has been completed when a user clicks the Previous button. Entering values in these fields now also makes it easy to obtain the newly created {{variable.Field_PM_PaymentMethodID}} and {{variable.Field_Transaction_TransactioID}} if you need either later in the flow.   Click {{variable.Button_Done}} .   Create a "Results" Screen Element Click the + symbol (Add Element) between the Payment Flow screen and the End. Enter a {{variable.SF_Flow_Label}} . (required) (In this example, we used “Results.”) Un-check the {{variable.SF_Flow_ShowHeader}} field since the component already contains a header. Review the footer configurations. Click {{variable.Button_Done}} .   Save Your Flow Click {{variable.Button_Save}} .   Enter a {{variable.SF_Flow_FlowLabel}} . Click the Advanced section and set {{variable.SF_Flow_Type}} = “Screen Flow.” Click {{variable.Button_Save}} . Run, test, and activate the flow before using it. Edit the Parent Object Page Layout Open the Parent Object record. In this case, it’s the {{variable.Object_Opportunity}} . Click {{variable.Button_Setup}} . Click Edit Page . Select the Flow component and drag and drop it to a narrow column on the page layout. If you have multiple Flows defined in {{variable.Product_Salesforce}} , select the name of the Flow you just created in the {{variable.Field_SF_PageLayout_Flow}} field. Ensure the {{variable.SF_Flow_PassRecordIDToVariable}} checkbox is checked.   Click {{variable.Button_Save}} . Navigate back to the Parent Object ( {{variable.Object_Opportunity}} ) record and try it out. Depending on how you've configured the PaymentChargeFlow component, it should look like one of the following images. For customer-facing users   For internal Salesforce users   Authorize.net Payment Gateway Configuration PREREQUISITE You must be an Authorize.net user to use the following fields. Do not use these fields for any other scenarios. It will cause Transactions to fail.   This update is a work in progress, and support for CVV and address validation for other features will occur in future updates. New Fields Object: {{variable.Object_PaymentGateway}} Field Label: {{variable.Field_PG_LiveValidationMode}} API Name: Live_Validation_Mode__c Data Type: checkbox Default Value: False (unchecked) Description:  If checked, the {{variable.Object_PaymentMethod}} will use the "liveMode" to submit a zero-dollar or one-cent {{variable.Object_Transaction}} (depending on the card type and the processor support) to confirm the card number belongs to an active credit or debit account.  If unchecked, the {{variable.Object_PaymentMethod}} will use the "testMode" to perform a Luhn mod-10 check on the card number, without further validation. Component: PaymentChargeFlow  Field: {{variable.SF_Flow_ShowAddress}}   Description: When enabled, additional address fields (Street, City, State, and Country) will be visible and required. Click here for more information about adding fields. Instructions To enable CVV validations when using an Authorize.net gateway and the PaymentChargeFlow component, check the new {{variable.Field_PG_LiveValidationMode}} field on the {{variable.Object_PaymentGateway}} record and add the {{variable.SF_Flow_ShowAddress}} field to the PaymentChargeFlow component.   When both are enabled, additional address fields (Street, City, State, and Country) will be visible and required, and the validation process will occur.
